project.name: Syirkah Reliability - Aggregator
project.description:
Phase 1 reliability (Docs/Plan/base00.md §"Reliability should be designed around business events", base01.md §P1-14, §P1-15, §P1-20):
idempotency same event arrives twice - process once retry transient failure - try again with backoff outbox write to the DB and publish atomically inbox same here - deduplicate before the domain sees it failure classify what may be retried and what may not
Reliability is designed around business events rather than around network calls, because the business event is the thing that must happen exactly once from the ecosystem's point of view.
